description: This source file defines the UserSessionListener interface which includes methods for tracking user login and logout events, along with associated statuses and event types within the OpenMRS system.

classes.name: UserSessionListener
classes.description: An interface for listening to user session events such as login and logout, including the status of these events.

methods.name: loggedInOrOut
methods.description: Method called to log either login or logout events, including the user, the event type, and the status.
